title: CI change detection and fast share one test-plan description
body: Evidence 2026-11-18: t-m1gv5fj (PR #1404) gave fast a reason per selected test and writes the plan to .krn/cache/fast-plan.json, but left scripts/ci-changes.mjs unchanged; its Outcome clause "fast and CI observation share the description" is not done.

Outcome: CI change detection (scripts/ci-changes.mjs) and fast describe a selection with the same plan description (shared module): selected test, reason (owner, import consumer, spawns entry, widened) and dependency path, and CI prints it in the Changes job summary.
Proof: a test feeds one changed-file list to both fast planning and ci-changes and asserts identical selection and reasons.
